browser.title: Traffic Impacts in Tuscarawas County | Ohio Department of Transportation

blocks.text: The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Belmont County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 11 on Facebook or X for current Tuscarawas County construction information.
blocks.textContent: The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Belmont County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 11 on Facebook or X for current Tuscarawas County construction information.

blocks.text: U.S. 250 - County Road 68 (Barnhill Road) closure: The Barnhill Road bridge over U.S. Route 250 near Midvale is closed to all traffic due to structural damage. The ramps to/from U.S. Route 250 will remain open at the interchange, though drivers cannot cross the bridge. Work will begin November 2 to begin repairing the bridge. The bridge will remain closed until repairs are complete. Learn more about the closure. Estimated Completion: December 31, 2026

blocks.text: State Route 258 daytime closures: November 9-20, SR 258 will close from West Chester to High Hill Road during daytime hours (7 a.m. to 4 p.m.), Monday through Friday, for tree-trimming work. The detour is U.S. 36 east to U.S. 250 east, U.S. 250 east to SR 800 south, SR 800 south back to SR 258, and reverse. Estimated Completion: November 20, 2026

blocks.text: West 3rd Street closure in Uhrichsville: The West 3rd Street bridge is closed from Water Street to West Jay Street for a bridge replacement project from July 13-November 30. Estimated Completion: November 30, 2026.
